lines.text: Start with usable cash, reserve bills and everyday essentials until your next reliable income, and keep unreflected payments from being counted twice.

items.text: Choose the end date: usually the next reliable income date.
Start with cash actually usable in the payment account.
Check pending debits, outstanding checks and transfers.
Reserve every bill due within the period, including annual charges, debt payments and any agreed deposit.
Allow for groceries, fuel, transport, care and other necessary spending before income arrives.
